project.name: OPlague
project.value_proposition: A read-only workstation for device inventory, bounded driver-package inspection, integrity evidence and reproducible diagnostic reports.
primary_users: Support teams preparing evidence before manual remediation
jobs_to_be_done: Inventory present Plug and Play devices without changing them
Inspect INF, ZIP and UDRV package metadata and integrity
Export bounded evidence for offline comparison and handoff

distribution: Source checkout and local Python execution
Windows desktop executable and release archive workflow
commercial_position.support_route: Community issue reporting through the repository's GitHub Issues; no response-time commitment or paid support SLA is offered.
commercial_position.privacy_posture: Device identifiers are pseudonymized for snapshot export; export requires operator acknowledgement. Inspection is local and read-only.

quality.requirement: Bound archive entries, paths, file sizes and compression before reading package metadata.
Validate manifest-declared files, sizes, hashes and paths without loading or executing payloads.
Retain source provenance and conflicts without converting metadata into a driver verdict.
Require explicit acknowledgement for inventory export and preserve non-mutating device workflows.
Verify the Windows desktop build and packaged application through the release workflow.

cohesion.requirement: Use a versioned JSON snapshot and schema for device evidence handoff.
Compose ordered inspection records and aggregates through one report contract.
Use the Pytyliki native ABI only through a caller-selected trusted library.
Keep Reaper reports and OPlague snapshots versioned and independently validated.
Maintain capability, evidence and safety boundaries in the repository contract.

commercial.requirement: Describe the diagnostics workflow and its audience without promising automated driver repair.
Document first-run instructions and the Windows packaging path.
Ship the Apache 2.0 license with distributable source and desktop artifacts.
State that the supported desktop target is Windows and distinguish source tooling from the GUI package.
Collect external user validation before publishing adoption, market-size or revenue claims.
commercial.reason: No validated customer interviews, conversion data or paid demand are currently published.

known_gaps: Driver installation, removal, enable/disable, signing, rollback and firmware changes are intentionally not implemented.
Compatibility dry-run edges are candidates, not driver rankings or compatibility verdicts.
No public pricing or paid support SLA is established.
